metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: BATBEG crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: 6(C2 H8 N1 1+),C22 H50 Ce4 N2 Na2 O150 Sn2 Te4 W36 6-,23(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, W1 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W2 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W3 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W4 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W5 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W6 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W7 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W8 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W9 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W10 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W11 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W12 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W13 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W14 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W15 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W16 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W17 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W18 (W) has 6 O neighbors; Ce1 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce2 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; W19 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W20 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W21 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W22 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W23 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W24 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W25 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W26 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W27 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W28 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W29 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W30 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W31 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W32 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W33 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W34 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W35 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W36 (W) has 6 O neighbors; Ce3 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce4 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; W3'? (W) has 0 O neighbors; W12'? (W) has 0 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 79 pairs, 3 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.360-4.329 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 86.16-158.60°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C34H212Ce4N8Na2O186Sn2Te4W36 (empirical formula reported in Table 1). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
